ShortDescription.Value: Beta road and junction marking tools with line/fill editing and native secondary-lane integration.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — road and junction marking tools.
WHAT IT DOES Creates and edits supported road/junction lines and area fills, including snapping and style controls.
HOW TO USE Open Magic Marking from its toolbar button or configured shortcut, select a road/junction and use the line or fill tools. Use the panel's delete/reset controls for the selected markings.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Complex topology and third-party road styles need broader testing. Some styles require their listed dependencies. This mod replaces the native secondary-marking generator; simultaneous use with another replacement marking engine is not guaranteed compatible. Keep backups before extensive editing.
Publish.ChangeLog:
2.4.1-beta.1 — Maintenance beta

Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
